name: Plagiarism Scan Report (Student)
description: Automatic plagiarism scan result sent to a student after they submit an assignment. The scan compares the submission against all other submissions already stored for the same assignment.
subject: Plagiarism Scan: $assignment_title
body_text:
Dear $first_name,

An automatic plagiarism scan has been run on your submission for '$assignment_title' ($module_code).

$verdict

Scan Details:
- Result: $status
- Highest similarity to an existing submission: $similarity_pct
- Documents compared against: $compared_count
$matches_info

If you believe this result is incorrect, contact your instructor. Every scan is also reviewed manually before any academic-misconduct action is taken.

$signature
body_html:
Plagiarism Scan Report

Dear $first_name,

An automatic plagiarism scan has been run on your submission for $assignment_title ($module_code).

$verdict

Scan Details:

  • Result: $status
  • Highest similarity to an existing submission: $similarity_pct
  • Documents compared against: $compared_count
    • $matches_info_html

If you believe this result is incorrect, contact your instructor. Every scan is also reviewed manually before any academic-misconduct action is taken.

$signature

status.description: One of EXACT_MATCH / HIGH_SIMILARITY / MODERATE_SIMILARITY / LOW_SIMILARITY / NO_MATCH / SKIPPED

similarity_pct.description: Highest similarity score as a percentage, e.g. '42.3%'

compared_count.description: Number of prior documents the submission was compared against

verdict.description: Human-readable one-sentence summary of the scan outcome

matches_info.description: Plain-text line describing matched documents, or empty

matches_info_html.description: HTML list item describing matched documents, or empty
